rationale: Sina's Tuurny is building computer vision and robotic systems for precision e-waste component recovery, while AJ's Seed Physical specializes in dexterous robotic manipulation and hardware-software co-design—two complementary robotics expertise areas that could inform each other. AJ's deep knowledge of robot learning and manipulation could strengthen Tuurny's autonomous harvesting systems, and Sina's real-world deployment experience in physical robotics offers practical grounding for AJ's manipulation research.
intro_message: Sina Ghashghaei, meet AJ Chahal — you're both building robotics systems for precise physical tasks in the SF area, and AJ's expertise in dexterous manipulation and robot learning could be valuable as Sina scales Tuurny's autonomous harvesting platform.
